data.title: 胡桃 · 和裕茶馆跨界听书
data.description: 【跨界想象·和裕茶馆】临窗雅座里，胡桃一手托腮，另一手端起青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，饶有兴致地听台上讲《三国演义》。红木桌上留着盖碗托碟与精致茶点；这次把现实小说搬进璃月茶楼的演出，让她也想试着给故事续一首打油诗。
data.action: 跨界听书时一手托腮，另一手举青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，托碟与茶点留在桌上
data.lighting: 茶楼雕花木窗滤过的柔和暖木色光影
data.promptProse: In an imagined crossover at Heyu Tea House, Hu Tao listens to a storyteller recounting Romance of the Three Kingdoms. She props one cheek in her left palm and raises a small celadon tea bowl in her right hand, gently blowing across the steam before a sip. The lid and saucer stay beside the pastries on the redwood table. Her dark sweater and red pleated skirt suit the leisurely visit. Filtered afternoon light draws the lattice pattern across the tabletop while her amused eyes follow the performance beyond the frame. No printed title or lettering.
